original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚信息部长呼吁民众拒绝选举冷漠与贿选
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚信息与国家导向部长穆罕默德·伊德里斯在阿布贾举行的2027年大选全国基层动员活动上，呼吁民众拒绝选举冷漠、贿选和选举暴力。警方重申将保障选举安全，并与独立国家选举委员会等合作。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚信息部长呼吁民众拒绝选举冷漠、贿选和选举暴力
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Minister of Information and National Orientation, Alhaji Mohammed Idris, has called on Nigerians to reject voter apathy, vote buying and electoral violence ahead of the 2027 general election.

key_facts.fact: 活动在阿布贾举行，由全国导向机构组织
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Idris made the call on Thursday in Abuja, at the commencement of the Nationwide Grassroots Mobilisation Campaign for the 2027 general election. The campaign was organised by the National Orientation Agency (NOA)

key_facts.fact: 警察总监重申警方将保障选举安全
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Inspector-General of Police, Olatunji Disu, reaffirmed the commitment of the Nigeria Police Force to provide a safe and secure environment for Nigerians to exercise their constitutional right to vote.
